acceptance_criteria.text: Normalize account, position, open-order and market-clock payloads into an application-owned AccountState with reconciliation timestamp and provenance.
Compute deterministic exact decimal long, short and gross exposure from the normalized open positions.
Reject malformed financial values, duplicate symbols/orders and inconsistent account snapshots without silently coercing data.
Replay the checked-in synthetic account reconciliation fixture offline without credentials, sockets or live market access.
